briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and xAI Colossus cluster push AGI timelines forward amid record funding

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models while compute buildouts accelerate globally. Safety concerns mount as production deployments face persistent threats.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4-preview achieves new benchmarks on agentic tasks; Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and Google Gemini 3.0 roll out with enhanced reasoning. Meta Llama 4 and DeepSeek-R2 compete on efficiency while xAI scales its Colossus supercluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize multi-agent security protocols.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters in Europe and Asia. TSMC reports record AI chip orders through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialects become mandatory for autonomous systems by 2028?
